text:
alex: quick thought 0 min q: can we add inline canary annotations to the timeline? i.e., tiny badges that show percent and a one-word confidence (stable/uncertain). goal: reduce clicks to assess safety.

jamal: inline badges are useful. i worry about visual noise if every version has one. maybe only show them for active rollouts and hovered groups.

maria: accessibility note: badges must not rely on color or icon alone. include readable text and an aria-describedby link to a short explanation. also provide a keyboard-only trigger to expand details.

alex: good call. proposal: compact badge = "2%  stable" (icon+text). tapping or focusing expands a small panel with: canary traffic, confidence reasons, recent error delta, main config diffs.

leo: engineering: we can compute a confidence score from sample size + anomaly detector output. suggest buckets: stable (>=0.8), cautious (0.5-0.8), uncertain (<0.5). we can return a short rationale string for the tooltip.

jamal: wording: for the badge, prefer "2%  stable" vs "Stable  2%"? the second reads better left-to-right in the timeline.

maria: for SR use: "Canary confidence: Stable. Traffic: 2%. Reason: sample size large; no error increase." keep each clause short for TTS.

tamika: interactions: keyboard focus on badge should reveal the panel on Enter/Space, and Escape should close it. for mobile, single tap toggles inline expand. ensure focus lands in the panel header when expanded.

alex: copy for the expanded panel header: "Canary snapshot: v12 -> v13 (2% traffic)". subtitle: "Confidence: Stable". body lines: "Recent errors: +0.1%", "Metric drift: none", "Change type: model weights + tokenizer".

leo: small ask from infra: keep the expanded panel under 280px and lazy-load heavy metrics links. we can return a short summary and a link "Open metrics" that navigates to the full view.

jamal: microcopy for the timeline footer when confidence low: "Confidence low: consider pausing or running a targeted test. Learn more." where 'Learn more' links to docs.

maria: SR live region: when the confidence bucket changes for an in-progress canary, announce politely: "Canary confidence changed to Cautious for v13". use polite politeness level to avoid interrupting screen reader users.

tamika: rollback naming: current button "Rollback" is ambiguous. options: "Pause rollout", "Revert to v12", "Pause & Revert". UX suggestion: primary action should be conservative: "Pause rollout"; secondary destructive action: "Revert to v12 (full rollback)".

alex: agreed. also add a confirmation modal copy: header "Pause rollout?" body: "Pausing will stop new traffic to v13 and keep current sessions running. To fully revert, choose Revert." buttons: "Pause rollout" and "Cancel". for revert modal: "Confirm revert to v12?" with a short risk reminder.

leo: we can add an audit note automatically to the revert action: "Revert triggered by <user> from console" to help ops. small privacy check required.

jamal: visuals: compact-mode toggle idea. timeline shows chips tightly spaced; in compact mode we hide timestamps and only show badges for active/hovered items. accessible label on toggle: "Toggle compact timeline view".

maria: ensure compact mode does not hide critical info for SR. if timestamps hidden visually, keep them available to SR via aria-hidden=false on a visually-hidden element.

alex: follow-ups: jamal mock two versions: default timeline with badges on active items only, and compact timeline with inline badges + keyboard expand. maria: draft SR strings for badges, panel, and live region messages. tamika: write the modal CTAs and confirm copy variants. leo: provide the confidence buckets and pseudocode for deriving them.

ui-bot: uploaded mock image  https://img.redwood/snapshots/canary-inline-proposal.png

jamal: targeting mock by tomorrow morning.

maria: SR snippets will be in a separate message.

leo: sending confidence pseudocode in a follow-up thread.

alex: thanks all, looks good  :thumbsup: we will review in design review.
